name: Turks and Caicos Islands
summary: The Turks and Caicos Islands has no direct taxation of any kind: no income, capital gains, dividend, inheritance, estate, gift, wealth or annual property tax. The material cost is stamp duty on buying land (up to 10% of the whole price on Providenciales). Gifts of land to a spouse, parent or child are exempt from stamp duty. Permanent Residence Certificates are available by investment (USD 1 million real estate on Providenciales, USD 300,000 on the smaller islands) plus a USD 25,000 PRC fee.

regimes.name: Ordinary residence
regimes.eligibility: Any lawful resident; non-belongers need a residence permit or Permanent Residence Certificate.

capital_gains.rate_basis: No direct taxation of any kind (Chambers Private Wealth 2025). All rates 0.

sources.title: Chambers Private Wealth 2025: Turks and Caicos Islands (Coriats Trust Company)

capital_gains.important_exceptions: Stamp duty on land purchases (whole value, not marginal): Providenciales and other islands not listed below: 0% under USD 25,000, 6.5% USD 25,000-250,000, 8% USD 250,000-500,000, 10% above USD 500,000. Grand Turk, North, Middle and South Caicos and Salt Cay: 5% USD 25,000-100,000, 6.5% above. Charged on the higher of price and market value, paid by the purchaser within 30 days. Changes in beneficial ownership of land-holding companies are taxed (8% x share fraction x land value).

sources.title: Chambers Private Wealth 2025: Turks and Caicos Islands (Coriats Trust Company)

dividends.withholding_outbound: No withholding taxes on dividends paid by TCI companies (no direct taxation).
dividends.treaty_network: No income tax treaties; US/EU source withholding on portfolio dividends is not reduced.

sources.title: Chambers Private Wealth 2025: Turks and Caicos Islands (Coriats Trust Company)

inheritance.summary: No inheritance, estate or gift tax (no direct taxation). No forced heirship.
inheritance.gift_tax: No gift tax. Gifts of land to (or in trust for) a spouse, parent or child are exempt from stamp duty; gifts to siblings, grandparents or grandchildren are exempt if the Permanent Secretary of Finance accepts there is no consideration.

sources.title: Chambers Private Wealth 2025: Turks and Caicos Islands (Coriats Trust Company)

open_questions: Stamp duty on land passing on death (transmission/assent) and probate fees were not found; no primary source (Stamp Duty Ordinance schedule) could be opened. other_transfer_cost_rate is kept at 0 pending a source.
inheritance.domicile_rules: No transfer taxes, so domicile is irrelevant locally.

residency.tax_residency_test: No direct taxes, so tax residence has no local consequence.

routes.name: Permanent Residence Certificate by investment
routes.requirements: Real estate for own home: USD 1,000,000 on Providenciales and other islands, USD 300,000 on Grand Turk, Salt Cay, South, Middle or North Caicos (IMI Daily); business route USD 750,000 on the smaller islands (higher on Providenciales, amount unverified). Certificate of Undertaking via Invest Turks and Caicos, then PRC; USD 1,500 admin fee and USD 25,000 PRC fee (TCI Government flowchart). Thresholds come from a secondary source and the government flowchart is undated.

sources.title: TCI Government: Permanent Residence Certificate Application Process - Investment Routes (flowchart)
IMI Daily: Turks & Caicos Investor Visa (Permanent Residence Certificate)

corporate.summary: No corporate income tax or withholding taxes. Economic substance, CRS and FATCA reporting apply; beneficial ownership regime being expanded (Chambers 2025).

sources.title: Chambers Private Wealth 2025: Turks and Caicos Islands (Coriats Trust Company)

us_citizen_notes: US citizens stay subject to US federal tax on worldwide income, gains and estate; with no local income tax there is no local tax to credit, so the US layer applies in full. No income tax treaty with the US.
open_questions: Whether Pillar Two / a domestic minimum top-up tax has been adopted (not found).
2026-27 budget tax measures not verified (Citizens' Guide PDF could not be read); no evidence of new direct taxes.
Homicide override not added: press reports (about 24 murders by mid-August 2025, 47-48 in 2024) are not an official full-year statistic.

Overall score: TCA has no WGI, CPI, HDI, LPI, learning-outcome or World Bank internet-use data. The TCI Department of Statistics crime-statistics page reads 'Information Coming Soon' (checked 15 Oct 2026) and no official internet-use percentage was found, so no indicator override is added. Even with a rent figure and an internet-use override, weighted data completeness would be about 0.598, still just below the 0.60 provisional threshold.
Prime rent rests on a single CENTURY 21 listing (USD 10,000 a month, Long Bay Hills); Turks & Caicos Sotheby's and Coldwell Banker TCI sites could not be read, so a broader sample is still needed.

intl_school_annual_fee.description: British West Indies Collegiate (Providenciales, non-profit 11-18 school, Cambridge IGCSE/A level), Years 9-13 tuition from September 2026: USD 5,013 a term, 15,039 a year (4% discount for full-year advance payment). Plus a USD 500 annual textbook fee and USD 500 enrolment fee (not included).

source.title: British West Indies Collegiate: Tuition fees 2026-2027 (fee changes from September 2026)

cost_of_living.notes: Purchase price per m2, health insurance and housekeeper not sourced. Other school fees from the school's Application and Fees page. CENTURY 21 rental page: https://century21tci.com/en/s/residential/for-rent

prime_rent_monthly.description: The only 4-5 bedroom long-term rental on CENTURY 21 Turks & Caicos's Providenciales residential rental page on 15 Oct 2026 (3 rentals listed in all): The Haven at Long Bay Beach, Long Bay Hills, 4 bed / 4.5 bath, 2,500 sq ft, fully furnished, USD 10,000 a month, first and last month's rent plus a USD 10,000 deposit, available from 1 June 2026. A sample of one listing; the other two were a 3-bed house in Blue Mountain (USD 5,500) and a 2-bed townhome (USD 3,500). CENTURY 21 notes a shortage of rentals on Providenciales.
